kids.chars: The §6 table: what to show before submit, per strategy

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: schedule table (slice #, planned time, size; SCR-066 A11y) with nominal times ± their window and size ranges (F25)

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: start price, the max-distance price, timeout

kids.name: c5
kids.chars: both legs: side, price, size, distance from mark, which is reduce-only

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: "about 20 orders in all; at most one every 250–500 ms" (refill delay)

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: "up to 2 price changes a second" (60 000 ÷ interval, E33-S05) and a typical estimate, shown against the account's remaining entry headroom including its running algos (SC-18): "With your running chase: 4 of 4 requests a second — no room for your own orders"; a refusal names projected and allowed rates and offers the nearest interval (E33-D02)

kids.name: c5
kids.chars: none needed: 2 orders, then one amend per partial fill or one cancel

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: one slice at today's book, (estimated) (CMP-130); the window-end worst case: "if 0.40 BTC is left at 14:30 UTC, it is sent at market up to your limit, 64,250.0" (with a participation cap instead, at most that share of recent volume, the rest left unfilled; with neither, it stays a limit order: SR-E33-03)

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: none: a post-only limit at a fixed price

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: the exact worst price, "64,012.0, 20 ticks from start"; with market fallback, a CMP-130 estimate for the rest

kids.name: c5
kids.chars: entry pair: "both could fill: worst case 2 × 0.50 BTC"

kids.name: c1
kids.chars: 5 · If CandleViewer stops or loses Bybit

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: "no new slices; one slice (0.07 BTC) at Bybit can fill"

kids.name: c3
kids.chars: "nothing refills; the visible order (≤ 0.30 BTC) can fill"

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: "the order stays at its last price and can fill"

kids.name: c5
kids.chars: entry: "both orders stay and both can fill"; exit: "the other exit stays; reduce-only"

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: the CMP-158 line and §3's stop sentence, the interim one until B8 reports protected for the symbol (SC-5); DEMO/LIVE text badge and account in the header and the SCR-076 restatement

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: SCR-066 previews "planned time" while 24 jitters times ±25 % and sizes ±20 %: exact times read as a promise the schedule will break.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: CMP-130 walks "the current orderbook WS snapshot … at order-entry time": it prices one slice now, not a schedule; a post-only iceberg has no slippage; a chase's worst price is exact.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: E33-S05 refuses a "disarmed user", while locked one-click means "every order requires confirmation" (US-ORD-005): one would arm one-click to start a TWAP (SC-9).

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: the builders have no keyboard path or focus order; SCR-076's 20 s auto-cancel can expire while a long restatement is read (05 §3.1 rule 4); and in the running modal the dialog's "Cancel" (dismiss: "cancel is always safe", 05 §3.4 item 4) sits beside "Cancel TWAP" (stop the run).

kids.name: sub
kids.chars: ST7: one per item listed in Probe E, plus a blank card (protocol §3). The keyboard-primary or magnification participant runs F (10) instead of E (protocol §4).

kids.name: copy
kids.chars: projected requests per second against the account's remaining headroom, counting running algos (report §6; E33-S05)

kids.name: line-2
